precedent: Ship hull ultrasonic antifouling transducers preventing biofouling via acoustic microstreaming; heat exchanger acoustic cleaning systems.
response_head:
INTERVENTION: Integrate ultrasonic transducers mounted on the cooling-tower drift eliminator and heat transfer fill surfaces, operating at 20–40 kHz to generate acoustic microstreaming and cavitation that mechanically detach early-stage biofilms and suspend sediment, preventing hardening and restoring heat/mass transfer coefficients.
MECHANISM_CLASS: ultrasonic_antifouling
ROOT_CAUSE: Biofilm and sediment fouling_deposition occurs due to low shear stress areas on heat exchanger surfaces allowing
